responsibility: Implements binding and lookup behavior for Rust patterns during AST name resolution. This file handles pattern forms that either introduce new bindings or refer to existing items, such as identifier, tuple, tuple-struct, struct, and range patterns, by inserting bound names into the current value scope, resolving referenced constructor or constant paths, and descending recursively through nested pattern structure used in lets, match arms, and closure parameters.
same_name_distinction: Implements the non-inline pattern-resolution behavior, especially recursive declaration handling for tuple, struct, tuple-struct, and range patterns and delegation to path resolution for pattern references. Unlike the matching header, this file supplies the out-of-line traversal logic beyond the header’s small inline cases.
